baseline_target: Frozen Candidate-B pre-funding target at current diagnostic NAV; not old filled absolute cash
finite_target: min(X * B_i, unchanged registered execution ceiling)
soft_budgets: Opportunity target, security tail, total tail and family tail scale together by X. Hard security cap does not scale.
max_fill: R1 priority, no opportunity/security/account/family soft-risk budget

hard.stock_liquidity: 1% lagged valid ADV20 else Native executable fallback
hard.ETF_liquidity: same registered 50% window and 100-share lot; Native target delta is B sizing, not window ceiling

native_state: Continuous actual holdings; no re-normalization. State-dependent legal requests may differ, but no source/alpha population is added.
unused_cash_method: Same-clock read-only nested deployment waterfall: security, liquidity/execution, soft opportunity/security/account, family. Gross and cash are redundant in an unfinanced long-only cashbook. Residual follows Native integer execution. Signed interactions are disclosed, not clipped. Daily cash provenance carries constraint attribution until next decision; new released cash is no qualifying opportunity until an eligible timestamp.
